description_en: Upgrades the major engine version of a Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance
description_zh: 升级云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的大版本
name: ModifyInstanceMajorVersion

parameters.help_en:
The major version to which the instance is upgraded.
Valid values for cloud-native instances: 6.0 or 7.0.
Valid values for classic instances: 4.0 (not recommended) or 5.0.
Only upgrades to the same deployment mode are supported
parameters.help_zh:
升级实例版本。
云原生版实例可升级的大版本取值：6.0或7.0。
经典版实例可升级的大版本取值：4.0（不推荐）或5.0。
仅支持升级至相同部署模式
parameters.name: major_version

parameters.help_en:
The time when the upgrade is performed. Valid values:
Immediately: The upgrade is performed immediately. This is the default value.
MaintainTime: The upgrade is performed during the maintenance window.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473775.html operation to modify the maintenance window of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
升级执行时间，取值：
Immediately：立即执行，默认值。
MaintainTime：在可维护时间段执行。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473775.html修改实例的可维护时间段
parameters.name: effective_time
